# DinWeys — dinweys.com

> Chinese food-ingredient exporter: potato flakes, frozen french fries, potato flour, kidney beans, broad beans, sesame, flaxseed and millet, supplied in bulk to importers, distributors and food manufacturers.

## Products
- [All Products](https://dinweys.com/products/): Full product range for bulk export.
- [Bulk Potato Flakes](https://dinweys.com/dinweys-bulk-potato-flakes/): Dehydrated potato flakes for food processing.
- [Potato Flour / Mashed Potato Flakes](https://dinweys.com/dinweys-potato-flour-mashed-potato-flakes/): Flours and mash bases.
- [French Fries — Bulk Manufacturer Direct](https://dinweys.com/1-4-french-fries-mccain-in-bulk-manufacturer-direct/): 1/4 cut frozen fries, factory-direct supply.
